# Kenney Furniture Kit - ordinary household selection

Three unmodified portable GLBs: bedSingle, table and bookcaseOpen.
Original source: https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit
Author: Kenney. License: CC0 1.0 Universal; exact source License.txt retained.

The selected GLBs use glTF 2.0 and embedded material colours. They declare no
external image textures. Their plain frames and broad faces suit the Paper
Theatre reference after a small palette/paper-surface change. Check scene scale
and pivots after private import; an edge bevel is optional. No electronics,
modern kitchen/bathroom fixtures, or redundant furniture variations are retained.

All three GLBs passed a separate Blender 5.2.2 LTS background import. Bed
and bookcase stock-material renders were inspected. The bed imports only
1.125 m long, the table 0.327 m high and the bookcase 0.880 m high; match
furniture scale to Elias before placement. The bed has three child meshes,
so preserve its hierarchy when preparing a derived working copy. Source
bytes and credit hashes remain unchanged. UE 4.27.2 validation is pending.
Per-file dimensions, mesh/material details, hashes and roles are in SOURCE.json.
